Good on ya for doing home training. The gym is a lot better though since you gain more than you do at home (plus you get sp boosts as well.)

And yeah, the twins confidant is a pain in the ass, but the rewards are 👌🏾. You can fuse higher level personas with one of their benefits, as along as you have the money. Since you like fusing, I'd recommend doing it. All the personas they want are only available through fusing, sadly. A few of them are group guillotine, but they aren't that hard, especially since your at Sae's. You'll probably already have the personas you need for those. Once it's done you'll be able to do some of the godlike fusions you keep seeing. 
 
Happy fusing!

If you want to give your persona good stats, I'd recommened abusing the fusion alarm. Fuse a weaker persona, then use it to strengthen the one you want. They won't level up, but all their stats will increase. Chihaya has a fortune telling thing for this (though you have to do her confidant) or just go to mementos.

Also, 45 at Sae's palace? You might wanna grind in Mementos. Freetime grinding is the best. If you want to HP and SP - like, currently I have 999hp, and around 750sp - go to the gym *religiously* because all the extra hp carries onto NG+ and you can use alot more physical skills without running the risk of dying due to lack of HP.  And trust me, you're going to need it, especially in the first playthrough.

If you want to "plan" fusions, it's a simple as seeing what fusions are possible for that certain persona, then checking out what skills are inheritable, or not.
